exact: envenomation resulting in positive regulation of blood pressure in another organism
envenomation resulting in positive regulation of blood pressure in other organism
venom-mediated increase in blood pressure in another organism

definition: A process in which an organism initiates, promotes, or enhances the narrowing (constriction) of blood vessels by small muscles in their walls in another organism via the action of a venom, concomittantly increasing blood pressure in the bitten/stung organism.
label: venom-mediated vasoconstriction
